documents.title: CSF 2.0 Reference Tool data: full CSF 2.0 Core with Implementation Examples, withdrawn elements and all Informative References (JSON)
documents.identifier: CPRT framework version CSF_2_0_0 (CSF 2.0 Reference Tool API: csf/elements)
documents.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
documents.license: Public domain — U.S. Government work (17 U.S.C. §105); not subject to copyright in the United States
documents.notes: PRIMARY ingestion source. Backing data of the official CSF 2.0 Reference Tool: nested Function > Category > Subcategory tree with Implementation Examples, 1st/3rd-party-risk tags, withdrawn CSF 1.1-lineage elements with withdrawal reasons, and 'externalRelationships' carrying every OLIR informative reference. Output is deterministic (byte-identical across repeated downloads) but the informative-reference content changes as NIST posts new OLIR mappings. Schema documented in STRUCTURE.md. Includes informative-reference mapping content contributed to NIST's OLIR program by non-NIST developers (e.g., CSA, CIS, SCF Council, Cyber Risk Institute, UK DSIT, independent submitters); that third-party material may be subject to its contributors' own terms.

documents.title: CPRT export of NIST CSF 2.0 (CSF_2_0_0), all elements (JSON)
documents.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
documents.license: Public domain — U.S. Government work (17 U.S.C. §105); not subject to copyright in the United States
documents.notes: Official Cybersecurity and Privacy Reference Tool (CPRT) 'JSON' export. Flat graph format: documents, relationship_types, elements (functions, categories, subcategories, implementation examples, withdrawal reasons, party tags, sort keys) and relationships (projection = parent/child, incorporated_into / moved_to = withdrawals, external_reference = SP 800-53 Rev 5.1.1 informative references). Server filename cprt-CSF_2_0_0-<timestamp>.json. Does not contain the non-800-53 OLIR mappings (use the Reference Tool elements JSON for those). Also carries 30 Category-level SP 800-53 Rev 5.1.1 family references (GV.PO, GV.RR, DE.AE) that are absent from the Reference Tool elements JSON.
